summary: docs/BIOME_TRAITS.md section 5 (Runtime infrastructure) with the full v1.1 trait list (sections 2 and 7) is in place, the probe and verify.ps1 cover classic and per-biome trait runs, and the audio has the Grow clips and the kill-reward cues. (1) Runtime/Biomes/BiomeTraitTable.cs (new) holds THE table, one line per biome: Liquide Inertia(420) Coalescence(2) KillShield(3); Feu Propagation(4,1) SparkSpeed(2.1) ScorchedEarth(15) KillInheritance(1); Electricite Conduction(1.3) ArcReach(1.4) SparkSpeed(1.5) RingInterval(10) KillSpeedBoost(0.1,0.3). Its keys equal TraitTestKit.LiquidV11Key / FireV11Key / ElectricV11Key (EditMode test). Resolve(biome) = table -> SaveData.TraitMatrix -> command line (-classic, -traits "<key>" or -traits default, -trait <Id>=0|1, repeatable) -> master switch SaveData.BiomeRulesOn. ResolveScripted(biome) (DemoScenario, probe, DevShot) = classic -> command line, never the saved options. Matrix API for the UI: IsAssigned / SetAssigned / MaskOf / DefaultMask / canonical text 'Id=LFE;...' (only rows that differ, '' = the table). No Core code knows a biome. (2) SaveData: BiomeRulesOn (default true, not a tuning change), TraitMatrix (canonicalized), TraitMatrixModified, ResetTraitMatrix; TuningModified also covers a modified matrix. LaunchArgs: Classic, TraitsKey, TraitToggles, TraitArgsError (logged once as an error), HasTraitArgs; HasTuningOverride counts -traits <key> and -trait. (3) GameSession.CreateRound / CreateAttract / RoundConfig set SimConfig.Traits = BiomeTraitTable.Resolve(the biome being played) on a config built from scratch each time; the attract re-resolves at every restart, and GameDirector applies a biome pick, the Options toggle or a matrix change to the attract match at once (RefreshAttractTraits restarts it only when its traits differ). StartRound logs the round's traits. (4) DemoScenario runs classic by default (CreateConfig unchanged) and takes ResolveScripted(biome); Monitor.EvaluateTraited checks what any trait set must keep (the classic story does not hold under Feu: its 2.1x spark catches the human in phase 2); DemoScenario.TraitShots plans extra screenshots from sim reads only (grow, reward, scorch, reach). PlayerProbe prints '[ProbeTraits] <key|classic>', asserts the story only in classic runs, takes trait_* shots, runs its bot round with the demo's traits; DevShot logs the traits and saves <biome>_trait_*.png. (5) verify.ps1: the classic probe now also requires the exact hash -ExpectedClassicHash 246577239DE179C4 and '[ProbeTraits] classic'; new default steps traits-liquid / traits-fire / traits-electric run the probe with -traits default at -fps 30 and -fps 144 (PASS, equal hashes, non-classic [ProbeTraits], hash different from classic). (6) Audio: ISfxClipSet.Grow (optional, extra slot SfxSlot.Grow outside SlotCount / Hash, so the wave C hashes stay): liquid GrowCreep, fire Spread, electric Creep, played at -18 dB for the human's own TerritoryGrew only, at most once per 2 s; shared cues for the human's kill rewards: KillInherit (inherit swell, plus the 20 ms capture pulse), SpeedUp (zip, pitched up per level), ShieldShimmer (and a softer, lower shimmer at ShieldEnded). Every new clip passes the wave C audio rules (peak 0.89, ends on an exact zero, phone-speaker loss 0.0 to 1.8 dB). Evidence: Build/traits-infra player, classic probe [ProbeHash] 246577239DE179C4 at -fps 30 and -fps 144; default-trait probes equal per biome at 30 / 144: Liquide 05AC27EE4F056FD0, Feu 3DF3952B7C1BC26E, Electricite 6C31B923BF6E308E (the same hashes as a headless dotnet run of the demo). The same hashes came out of the final build (8 runs, TestResults/traits-infra_probe_*). Each probe still ends FAIL for another package only (on the final build the single reason is EuropeMap has no _PIO_ShaderId; the first build also caught LiquidComposite / ElectricOverlay mid-edit); scenario checks PASS, no error or exception logged. DevShots on the clean build show the Propagation frame, scorched ash with embers (Feu without KillInheritance), the reach contact and the killers' rewards. EditMode: 13 new tests; a 14-suite subset of 138 cases is all green.
api_additions: static class BiomeTraitTable (Runtime/Biomes): const DefaultKeyword "default"; Defaults(BiomeId) / DefaultKey(BiomeId) / IsDefault(TraitId, BiomeId) / DefaultMask(TraitId) (bit b = BiomeId b) / SpecFor(TraitId, BiomeId) / LetterOf(BiomeId); matrix: MaskOf(TraitId), IsAssigned(TraitId, BiomeId), SetAssigned(TraitId, BiomeId, bool), ParseMatrix(string), FormatMatrix(IDictionary<TraitId,int>), CanonicalMatrix(string), FromMatrix(BiomeId, string); resolution: Resolve(BiomeId), ResolveScripted(BiomeId), ApplyCommandLine(RuleTraits, BiomeId), Compose(RuleTraits, BiomeId, bool classic, string traitsKey, IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<TraitId,bool>>); IsDefaultKeyword(string), TryParseTraitId(string, out TraitId)

SaveData: bool BiomeRulesOn (key pio.BiomeRulesOn, default true), string TraitMatrix (key pio.TraitMatrix, canonical text, '' = the table), bool TraitMatrixModified, void ResetTraitMatrix(); TuningModified is also true when the matrix differs from the table

LaunchArgs: bool Classic (-classic), string TraitsKey (-traits, a valid RuleTraits key or 'default'), IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<TraitId,bool>> TraitToggles (every -trait <Id>=0|1, on/off/true/false, id by name or number), string TraitArgsError, bool HasTraitArgs; HasTuningOverride also true for -traits <key> (not 'default') and any -trait

GameSession: RuleTraits Traits (Sim.Config.Traits), bool RefreshAttractTraits(), static BiomeId ActiveBiome(), static SimConfig RoundConfig(ulong seed, bool lassoEnabled, RuleTraits traits); RoundConfig(seed, lasso) now carries Resolve(ActiveBiome())

DemoScenario: CreateConfig(RuleTraits), CreateSimulation(out Monitor, RuleTraits), CreateSession(out Monitor, BiomeId?, RuleTraits); Monitor.Traited, Monitor.EvaluateTraited(out List<string>); sealed class TraitShots(Simulation) { const GrowDelay 10, RewardDelay 18, ScorchDelay 30, ReachScale 1.25, ReachLeadTicks 2; Planned; PendingCount; bool TryTake(long tick, out string name); Detach() }
PlayerProbe: log line '[ProbeTraits] <key|classic>'; traited runs add screenshots trait_grow / trait_reward / trait_scorch / trait_reach. DevShot: <biome>_trait_<name>.png

ISfxClipSet.Grow (AudioClip, optional); SfxSlot.Grow = 8 (extra slot); SfxClipSamples.AllSlotCount = 9 (SlotCount stays 8 and Hash() covers the 8 base slots); LiquidSfx.Grow / FireSfx.Grow (ElectricSfx inherits LiquidSfx's)

SfxId.GrowCreep = 14 (biome slot, liquid Grow), KillInherit = 15, SpeedUp = 16, ShieldShimmer = 17 (shared); SfxSynth.ClipCount = 18; FireSfx.Clip.Spread = 8 (FireSfx.ClipCount = 9); ElectricSfx.Clip.Creep = 8
Sfx: const GrowGainDb -18, GrowRepeatSeconds 2.0, ShieldEndGainDb -9, ShieldEndPitch 0.7; internal HandleEventForTests(SimEvent)

tools/verify.ps1: steps traits-liquid, traits-fire, traits-electric (in the default order after probe-electric); parameter -ExpectedClassicHash (default 246577239DE179C4, '' skips); Invoke-PlayerProbe -extraArgs
contract_issues: Section 5 resolution order puts the master switch LAST, so SaveData.BiomeRulesOn = false also overrides -traits / -trait given on the command line (implemented literally; -classic and the option agree anyway). If the command line should win, swap the last two steps of BiomeTraitTable.Resolve.

Config traits vs the 15.2 test settings: SparkSpeed (Feu 2.1, Electricite 1.5) and RingInterval (Electricite 10 s) are applied by the Simulation constructor after the Runtime built SimConfig from SaveData.SparkFactor / RingDelay and -sparkFactor / -ringInterval, so in those biomes the trait wins over the slider and the command-line value (11.2 predates traits). To test a slider there: untick the trait in the matrix or pass -trait SparkSpeed=0 / RingInterval=0. User decision whether test settings should win instead.

Matrix parameters (section 5 only says 'trait -> set of biomes'): a trait ticked for a biome whose table line does not list it takes TraitDefaults' parameters (SparkSpeed 2.1 in Liquide; Electricite keeps its own 1.5). Matrix text: only the rows that differ from the table, 'Id=LFE' or 'Id=-', ascending id, '' = the table; the setter canonicalizes, unknown rows are dropped.

Command line additions beyond section 5: '-traits default' (also 'defaults' / 'biome') = the biome's table line without the saved matrix (the per-biome probes use it); -trait is repeatable and applied in order; a bad flag is logged once as an error (which also fails a probe). In scripted sessions (probe, DevShot, DemoScenario) the base is classic, so '-trait X=1' alone gives X alone; '-traits default -trait X=0' gives 'defaults minus X' (section 5's 'on top of the biome defaults' describes the game path).

18.2 step 3 under traits: the classic story (saved chased return, LassoPocket in the second exit, death by the spark in the second exit) does not hold under every set: Feu's 2.1x spark catches the human in phase 2 (tick 493), Electricite shifts the checkpoint timings (second cut 2.9 u behind the head, caught at tick 849). A traited probe asserts Monitor.EvaluateTraited (an unchased phase-1 capture before any cut, every checkpoint reached, EventCapHits 0), the hash at EndTick and the usual shader / screenshot / log checks, and logs the story as information; the human-paint guard applies only while the human is alive.

Section 6 'equal hashes per biome': with the v1.1 defaults the demo hashes are Liquide 05AC27EE4F056FD0, Feu 3DF3952B7C1BC26E, Electricite 6C31B923BF6E308E (equal at -fps 30 and 144 and to a headless run). They change with any table or parameter change (for example the proposed Inertia 480 / SparkSpeed 2.3), so verify does not pin them: it checks their equality across rates and that they differ from the classic hash. The classic hash IS pinned now (18.4 implied amendment).

18.4: verify.ps1's default order gains traits-liquid, traits-fire and traits-electric (6 more player runs, about 5 min); the probe step also fails when the classic hash is not 246577239DE179C4 or [ProbeTraits] is not 'classic'.

25.2 / 26.6: ISfxClipSet gains the optional Grow member and SfxSlot.Grow = 8 as an extra slot: SlotCount (8) and SfxClipSamples.Hash keep covering the eight base slots (the wave C hashes are unchanged), while Build and the background loader make AllSlotCount (9) clips ('Build(rate) equals BuildSlot over Synthesize(rate)' now over 9 slots). 16 haptics gains one line: the human's TerritoryInherited pulses the 20 ms capture haptic.

11.1 / 11.2 / 26.4: a biome pick, the 'Regles des biomes' toggle or a matrix change restarts the attract match at once with a new seed when its traits differ (GameSession.RefreshAttractTraits, raises Restarted like the round-end restart), without the UI AttractCover fade (for a biome pick it coincides with the biome look swap). Real rounds keep their traits until they end.
Stats (11.1): -traits <key> and -trait count as tuning overrides like a modified matrix (stats not saved); -classic and '-traits default' do not, like BiomeRulesOn = false.

BIOME_TRAITS 6 player screenshots: the probe and DevShot take event-driven trait shots planned from sim reads only (trait_grow: the human's first TerritoryGrew + 10 ticks; trait_reward: first kill reward + 18; trait_scorch: first elimination whose freed cells are scorched + 30; trait_reach: first enemy head within 1.25 x ContactRadius plus a 2-tick lead of an exposed trail point involving the human, ArcReach only). The 18.2 shot list gains these names; a classic run takes none (its 8 shots are unchanged).
open_issues: Every probe of my builds ends [ProbeResult] FAIL for other packages only: 'PainterIO/EuropeMap has no _PIO_ShaderId' (europe package, every run), and on the first build (01:49) LiquidComposite / ElectricOverlay ran a 1-pass fallback while traits-fx edited them (magenta shots). Hashes, the scenario check (classic story in classic, EvaluateTraited in traited runs), the trait shots and the logs (no error, no exception) pass. Builder.SetupAndCompile FAILs on ShaderCheck for the same EuropeMap reason.

Only a 14-suite EditMode subset was run (138 cases, all green: my 13 tests plus Sfx, WaveC audio, fire, DemoScenario, RuntimeSkeleton, game flow, biome, strings, UI, infra, actor and liquid render suites). The full EditMode and the PlayMode suites were not run: the tree was being edited by four agents and two runs were blocked by their compile errors in progress (BiomeRulesView.cs CS0136, SeveredTerritoryTests.cs CS0051, both fixed since). Core is untouched by this package, so the dotnet loop was not run.

My verify.ps1 runs (-Steps probe,traits-liquid,traits-fire,traits-electric, agent traits-infra) rewrote docs/verify_last.txt with that partial run (OVERALL FAIL, EuropeMap only), as every verify run does.
The new sounds are judged by measurement only (peak 0.89, RMS 0.13 to 0.23, phone-speaker loss 0.0 dB for the cues, 1.8 dB for the electric creep), not by ear.

The reach screenshot is a heuristic (2-tick lead): on the final build it lands 4 ticks before the cut (tick 369, cut at 373), with the attacker's head about 1.4 x ContactRadius from the trail, so the arc (shown within 1.25 x) may not be lit in that frame yet. FX agents tune their visuals with DevShot anyway: '-devshot <dir> -biome electric -traits default', '-biome fire -traits default -trait KillInheritance=0' (growth then scorched ground), '-biome liquid -traits default'.

Feu trait_reward on the final build (18 ticks after the kill): the inherited land is drawn as grey ash (the neutralize) with the killer's saffron front only just starting at the victim's head; kill-core asked for the killer-colored fill over the cells instead of (or right after) the neutralize. Presentation belongs to the FX package; the shot is there to judge it.
